pool.text: Admiral Pedro Menendez de Aviles claimed the region for Spain.
Spain ceded the Florida territory to the United States.
Coconut Grove was settled before later being annexed into Miami.
Miami was officially incorporated as a city with a small population.
Coral Way was built as a historic residential neighborhood.
Coconut Grove was officially annexed into Miami.
Fidel Castro rose to power in Cuba during the revolution.
The region hosted presidential nominating conventions during the election.
The Calle Ocho Festival began running as a major music event.
The Miami Jewish Film Festival was established to celebrate cinema.
The local government went bankrupt in the area.
Miami hosted the Free Trade Area of the Americas negotiations.
Univision announced plans to build a new production studio.
The Miami Intermodal Center was completed to serve commuters.
Colleges and universities graduated thousands of students together.
Telemundo filmed a vast majority of its original programming locally.
Phase I of MiamiCentral Station was successfully completed.
The Gross Metropolitan Product reached billions of dollars.
Newspapers left their longtime home located in Downtown Miami.
The Port of Miami Tunnel opened to connect major roadways.
